name: v1-main

definitions.mean_delay_s: Mean SUMO timeLoss (s/veh) of trips that depart in [warmup, end) and finish (primary endpoint).
definitions.ci95: Half-width of the 95 % t confidence interval over seeds (mean ± ci95); null with one seed.
definitions.delta_vs_baseline_pct: Paired improvement in mean delay vs the baseline on matched seeds: mean over seeds of 100 × (baseline − candidate) / baseline. Positive = better (less delay) than the baseline.
definitions.mean_delay_diff_s: Paired difference candidate − baseline in mean delay (s/veh); negative = better.
definitions.p_value: Two-sided paired t-test on the per-seed delay differences.
definitions.p_holm: p_value after Holm–Bonferroni correction over the candidates of the same scenario.
definitions.unfinished_pct: 100 × (trips still in the network at the end + trips never inserted) / (completed + unfinished) (PERF-01).
definitions.ev_mean_travel_time_s: Mean travel time of emergency vehicles that finished.
definitions.baseline_match: 'exact' = baseline run with the same coverage/sampling, 'scenario' = same scenario, other coverage.

commands: python -m teamb.experiments run --name v1-main --scenarios rush_hour,emergency --controllers fixed_time,coordinated,actuated,max_pressure,ai_recommender,rl --seeds 1-3 --end 2700 --workers 6 --controller-params '{"ai_recommender": {"auto_approve": true}}'
